answer_1.quote: We have developed a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs generate high-quality questions in the field of education
answer_1.outputs: Educational questions across memory, understanding, application, analysis, evaluation, and creation levels

answer_2.quote: We adopt consistency, relevance, coverage, and representativeness to evaluate LLMs' generated questions

answer_3.quote: We adopt GPT-4 to score each question three times
methods: binary scoring using GPT-4 with specific criteria

answer_4.quote: we randomly select 1000 questions generated by each LLM for each task and ask three volunteers to manually evaluate the generated responses using the same criteria applied to GPT-4
answer_4.guideline: using the same criteria applied to GPT-4: consistency, relevance, coverage, and representativeness
